items.rationale: A fixed, permanently wired AC unit is a building component (4.2.2), and lightning overvoltage is insured (2.3.3), but the description does not say the surge came from lightning. If covered, like-for-like replacement is paid at the reference price level (~1,413 per unit).
Installation is an ancillary charge and follows its principal item (7.1.11). It is payable only if the replaced unit is covered; references put it at about 480.

An equivalent stand replacing a surge-damaged console belongs to a like-for-like replacement and is not new equipment. However, it is tied to the living-room unit, which is not invoiced, so coverage is uncertain; reference price is about 61.
Freight is an ancillary charge that follows its covered principal item (7.1.11). The reference level is about 43.
